Description: Verify 'Processing status' tile is visible on the dashboard.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and has access to the dashboard.
Expected Result: A new tile named 'Processing status' (Bearbeitungsstatus) is present on the dashboard.

Description: Verify the tile displays the 'saved' status for a record.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. A record has been created/edited and saved, but not sent for approval.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Observe the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry for the saved record, indicated by a save icon.

Description: Verify the tile displays the 'for approval' status for a record.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. A record has been sent for approval.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Observe the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry for the record pending approval, indicated by a single orange tick icon.

Description: Verify the tile displays the 'approved' status for a record.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. A record has been approved.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Observe the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry for the approved record, indicated by a green double tick icon.

Description: Verify activating the tile opens a pop-up with processing actions.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. There are records in 'saved', 'for approval', or 'approved' state.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Click on the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: A pop-up appears, showing a list of all actions currently being processed.

Description: Verify navigation from pop-up to the original mask for a specific action.
Pre-conditions: The 'Processing status' pop-up is open and displays at least one action.
Steps: 1. From the pop-up, identify and click on a selectable area for a specific action.
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the original mask (e.g., the 'Bearbeiten' page) for that specific record.

Description: Verify user can continue the release process after navigating from the pop-up.
Pre-conditions: User has navigated to the original mask from the 'Processing status' pop-up.
Steps: 1. On the original mask, perform the next logical action in the release process (e.g., click 'Send for Approval').
Expected Result: The release process continues as expected from the original mask.

Description: Verify tile behavior when no actions are being processed.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. There are no records in 'saved', 'for approval', or 'approved' state.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Observe the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: The tile is either empty or displays a message indicating 'No actions being processed'. [Needs Clarification on exact behavior]

Description: Verify pop-up behavior when tile is activated with no actions.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. There are no records in 'saved', 'for approval', or 'approved' state.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Click on the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: A pop-up appears, showing an empty state or a message indicating 'No actions being processed'. [Needs Clarification on exact behavior]

Description: Verify tile behavior with a large number of processing actions.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in. A very large number of records (e.g., 100+) are in various processing states.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Observe the 'Processing status' tile and the pop-up.
Expected Result: The tile and pop-up handle the large volume of data gracefully, possibly with a scrollbar in the pop-up, without UI degradation or performance issues.

Description: Verify tile behavior for a user with 'Viewer' role permissions.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the dashboard.
2. Observe the 'Processing status' tile.
Expected Result: The 'Viewer' can see the 'Processing status' tile and open the pop-up to view actions, but cannot initiate any state changes.
